title: Exact determinant characters for truncated-polynomial multiplication tensors
body:
This scoped proof answers the truncated-polynomial nilpotent case left open by [PR #5252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5252). For multiplication in F_q[t]/(t^n), it gives the full covariant stabilizer determinant image, three bounded character equations, and the exact splitting of its GL orbit into SL orbits. Extraction uses q and n under an explicit orbit promise. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c777c9a4b5f50a0e1561b2e24304486f40e8d001/research/truncated-tensor-characters/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c777c9a4b5f50a0e1561b2e24304486f40e8d001/research/truncated-tensor-characters/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c777c9a4b5f50a0e1561b2e24304486f40e8d001/research/truncated-tensor-characters/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c777c9a4b5f50a0e1561b2e24304486f40e8d001/research/truncated-tensor-characters/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 1,734 literal attaining maps, seven complete stabilizer domains with 260,985 input-map pairs and 1,729 autotopisms, and seven controls. Both print `PASS_TRUNCATED_TENSOR_CHARACTERS`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/truncated-tensor-characters
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39992835239](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39992835239). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Extend the character calculation to a specified multivariable local algebra or recognize the orbit promise. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #5252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5252) for the finite-etale result, the inverse-input convention and the explicit nilpotent follow-up. Its [pinned proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/07e6f55d18d2d3fd6dcea19bd642d71657c5fe14/research/etale-tensor-determinant-image/README.md) is context, not an imported algorithm. Credit David Ganz's [PR #2849](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2849) for atlas A019 normalization, A029 character equations and A030 extraction. Classical isotopy, cyclic-group and truncated-polynomial-algebra facts retain their credit. No general literature-priority claim is made.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
